beats.summary: Oscar reveals a $4300 budget surplus that must be spent by the end of the day or it will be deducted from next year's budget.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: You can see clearly on this page that we have a surplus of $4300.
Oscar: But we have to spend that by the end of the day or it will be deducted from next year's budget.

beats.summary: Office staff debate how to spend the surplus money, with Michael initially favoring a new copier and others suggesting new chairs or air quality improvements.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Yes, Michael, new chairs. These chairs are terrible. We were supposed to get new ones last year.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam have a disagreement over whether to spend the surplus on a copier or chairs, reflecting their differing preferences.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Uh, actually, I'm gonna go with copier.

beats.summary: Andy and Dwight discuss wedding plans at Schrute Farms, including directions and concerns about the venue's bathroom and slaughterhouse.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Dwight, I'm a little concerned about some of these directions to Schrute Farms…
Dwight: This is where you'll have your receiving line. Of course we'll clear out all the livestock and hay and such.

beats.summary: Michael and Jim go to lunch together, seemingly bonding over the budget surplus situation.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Really? Absolutely! Yeah, that would be amazing.
